about.heading: A Name Rooted in Two Sacred Trees
about.paragraph1: Arasamaram Aalamaram Enterprises takes its name from two of the most revered trees in Tamil culture — the Arasamaram (Peepal) and the Aalamaram (Banyan) — symbols of endurance, shelter, and growth across generations.
about.paragraph2: Just as these trees spread wide canopies while staying rooted in tradition, our enterprise has grown from humble beginnings into a diversified group spanning finance, healthcare, manufacturing, and frontier technology — always sheltering the communities and partners who grow with us.
about.paragraph3: Today, we operate across 19 core industries and are actively investing in 13 emerging technology domains, guided by a simple philosophy: strong roots enable fearless branches.
about.valueDesc1: Decades of trust built on tradition and integrity.
about.valueDesc2: A presence across nearly every major industry.
about.valueDesc3: Actively building the technologies of tomorrow.
